verdict: M251r2 closes the fixed12 arithmetic defect found in M251r1: full signed INT8 is [-128,127], so a 16-term PWP spans [-2048,2032], which still fits signed12 [-2048,2047]. The correction analyzer is fail-closed, rejects a wrong SHA before creating output, and clean replay is byte-identical; all M251 cycle values are unchanged. Independently, all 40 M248 packed support payloads and all 40 float-value payloads rehash, expand into 51,840,000 partition vectors, and reproduce every population/work/cycle total without importing the M251 analyzer. Natural candidate work is 1.5406415197256267x lower than bit-sparse. The declared WIDE144 model is 18.833088225777775x versus dense and 1.5405574102292159x versus bit-sparse; SHARED96 is 15.072002904483751x versus dense and 1.2328984754458552x versus bit-sparse. These are isolated four-Conv simulator results, not PAFT-versus-control gain, RTL-integrated throughput, energy, system speedup or a headline.

train_only_catalog_audit.qualification: The frozen M77 builder is fail-closed when its M73 raw inputs are present, but this handoff contains only the catalog and co-produced admission. The zero-leakage statement is transitively hash-bound, not independently reconstructable from the current incoming directory.

independent_cycles.resource_interpretation: One-cycle 144-byte PWP vector service and one-cycle 96-byte weight vector service
One shared 96-byte service width; 144-byte PWP vectors take two cycles

findings.title: Current M77 handoff cannot independently reconstruct the train/valid leakage proof
findings.evidence: The catalog and admission declare 32 train samples, 18 train sequences and zero valid825 key overlap, and their hashes are consistent. The raw M73 trace plus train/valid key lists consumed by the builder are absent from the incoming M77 directory.
findings.required_fix: Transfer or directly hash-bind the raw M73 trace and both split lists, then rerun the zero-overlap audit in the final artifact.

findings.title: Cycle overlap is an abstract simulator schedule, not an executable datapath boundary
findings.evidence: Every one of 17,280 phases is compute-bound under max(compute, matcher, packer, next-DMA), so matcher, packing and next-phase traffic are perfectly hidden. No integrated RTL/VCS cycle equality proves this dependency schedule or its startup/backpressure behavior.
findings.required_fix: Implement or trace-drive a matched matcher/packer/PWP service boundary with exact dependencies, finite queues and stalls before calling these hardware throughput measurements.

findings.title: WIDE144 is not width/area/frequency normalized against SHARED96
findings.evidence: WIDE144 gives a 144-byte PWP vector one-cycle service while ordinary weights use 96 bytes; matcher, PWP port, storage and routing area/frequency are unmodeled. SHARED96 is the conservative equal-width case.
findings.required_fix: Lead with both resource points and obtain matched Synopsys area/fmax/energy for the full service island before selecting WIDE144 as a preferred design.

findings.title: No running-BN no-PAFT hardware trace exists
findings.evidence: M247 supplies paired valid825 accuracy context, but the exact no-PAFT running-BN bottleneck support trace was not captured. Therefore the simulator measures the PAFT trace against execution baselines, not the hardware improvement caused by PAFT.
findings.required_fix: Capture the paired control checkpoint with identical samples, running-BN policy and payload schema, then report paired work/cycle deltas.

findings.title: Universal fixed12 capacity is not an INT8 numerical execution bridge
findings.evidence: The range proof is exact, but the PAFT checkpoint has no frozen INT8 export/Acc19 proof and no materialized PWP numeric payload demonstrating output-equivalent arithmetic through the Conv/BN/ATLIF boundary.
findings.required_fix: Export exact quantized weights/PWPs and prove integer output equivalence or bounded error through the downstream boundary.

findings.title: Dense ratios mostly reflect pre-existing natural sparsity
findings.evidence: The same trace is already 12.225647387x lower-work under bit-sparse execution than dense. PWP's incremental ratios are 1.540557410x WIDE144 and 1.232898475x SHARED96.
findings.required_fix: Always pair dense speedups with the bit-sparse baseline and identify the incremental PWP contribution.

findings.title: Trace coverage is ten samples from one sequence
findings.evidence: Exactness applies to 40 records from one frozen PAFT-ep4 running-BN ten-sample capture, not cross-sequence or dataset-wide source statistics.
findings.required_fix: Extend the identical capture and replay contract across DSEC sequences and event-density strata.

findings.title: Pattern-table residence and startup traffic are not explicitly charged
findings.evidence: M251 reports a 55,296-byte pattern table but does not charge its load in the phase traffic equation. This is harmless only under an explicit resident-table assumption or when amortized over a declared inference batch.
findings.required_fix: Declare residency and capacity, or add cold/warm startup rows including table traffic.

findings.title: Accuracy support is a small single-seed direction only
findings.evidence: M247 reports +0.573021510% running-BN AEE improvement and correctly labels it small/single-seed, so it cannot support a robustness or headline claim.
findings.required_fix: Add seed and sequence confidence intervals while preserving the paired evaluation contract.

allowed_claims: On the frozen M87 PAFT-ep4 running-BN ten-sample four-Conv trace, 40 exact payload records expand to 51,840,000 independently replayed 16-bit partition vectors.
The one-PWP-plus-signed-Hamming candidate reduces exact vector work by 35.092% versus the declared bit-sparse baseline, a 1.5406415197256267x natural work ratio.

Under the declared isolated model, WIDE144 is 18.833088225777775x versus dense and 1.5405574102292159x versus bit-sparse; SHARED96 is 15.072002904483751x versus dense and 1.2328984754458552x versus bit-sparse.
M251r2 corrects the universal 16-term signed-INT8 range to [-2048,2032]; signed12 remains safe and M251 cycle values are unchanged.
The M251r2 correction fails closed on a wrong SHA and clean replay is byte-identical.
forbidden_claims: M251r1's old [-2032,2032] exact range remains valid
18.833088x or 15.072003x is PAFT's incremental gain, full-network speedup or system speedup
WIDE144 is resource-equivalent or throughput-per-area superior to SHARED96
The simulator is an RTL-integrated cycle measurement
PAFT has proven hardware gain over the no-PAFT running-BN control
The checkpoint has a proven INT8/Acc19 numerical bridge
M251/M251r2 proves power, energy, paper-ready PPA or a DATE headline

next_gate.first: Transfer/hash-bind the raw M73 leakage inputs and capture the paired running-BN no-PAFT support trace.
next_gate.second: Materialize the INT8/PWP numerical bridge and an executable matched matcher/packer/service schedule.
next_gate.third: Run matched Synopsys resource/frequency/power points, then report dense and bit-sparse comparisons together across broader sequences.
